title: Hospital membership and approval
note: Only the administrator changes membership; the contract emits an auditable event.

title: Delegated training-client authorization
note: Approved owners authorize a delegate through the server-verified consent workflow.

title: Register a hospital model update
note: Binds the update CID and digest to its signer, round and incoming global model.

title: On-chain peer-validation decision
note: Confusion counts determine above-chance and non-degradation checks; this is an attestation.

title: Publish the global model reference
note: Requires completed reviews; when all updates are rejected, the prior digest is retained.

title: Local FedProx optimization
note: Class-weighted cross-entropy plus the proximal penalty; training remains off-chain.

title: Validation-aware aggregation weights
note: Accepted mass = local samples x mean peer balanced accuracy; rejected updates get zero weight.

title: Retrieve and verify an IPFS checkpoint
note: Downloads to a temporary file and checks SHA-256 before exposing the checkpoint.
